messages:
alex: Quick Q — proposing a minimal "connector.api" between customer VPC agent and controlplane for VPC-isolated customers. Two modes: 'proxy-relay' (relay everything through our regional relay) vs 'connector-only' (outbound ephemeral tunnels + local SNAT). Thoughts?
maya: curious about what you mean by "minimal" — auth surface + health + metrics only?
alex: yeah. Auth + ping/health + route-registration + per-request token exchange. No data-plane proxying unless customer opts in.
sam: +1 on minimizing data surface. Main tradeoff I see: SNAT approach preserves egress ips but we pay per-customer NAT footprint, and complex troubleshoot if customer changes subnets.
irene: also think about cert rotation & bootstrap path for airgapped on-prem — connector-only needs a pull model for certs or pre-seeded CA.
dave: cost-wise relay has variable egress (ours) but fewer customer infra docs. Connector-only pushes complexity to ops when networking breaks.
alex: propose we add config flag connector.mode = ["relay","ephemeral","hybrid"]. Hybrid = control plane via ephemeral tunnels + optional relay fallback.
maya: hybrid seems safe for rollout. Can we define semantics for failover? e.g., 30s probe + switch to relay for 2m, then retry connector?
sam: +1. Add hysteresis otherwise we get flapping. Also need a kill-switch from console for customers to force-relay.
irene: for certs: use short-lived certs minted from controlplane CA via signed CSR over the tunnel after identity proof. For airgapped, onetime bootstrap token with expiry & rotation policy.
ops-bot: deploy-status: connector-service v2.3 deployed to staging (sha:abc123) :rocket:
dave: ops-bot — can you add a smoke check that simulates an intermittent NAT change and fails open to relay path?
ops-bot: task created #OPS-942 — smoke-test: connector -> NAT-change -> relay-failover
alex: sample config sketch: ```yaml
connector:
  mode: hybrid
  failover:
    probe_interval: 30s
    relay_grace: 120s
  identity:
    csr_ttl: 15m
    bootstrap_token_ttl: 1h
```
maya: question on observability — we need per-tenant latency & egress-cost counters by path. Also tag metrics with path=relay/connector/ephemeral.
sam: and traces should include hop metadata (connector-id, region, failover_count). If connector is local, add extra kv for customer_snat_ip.
irene: migration plan: default new customers get hybrid; existing relay-only customers remain. After 3 months, opt-in invites for connector-only with a network checklist and staged rollout.
dave: we should run a chaos experiment that tears down connector control channel for 5m and measure error budget impact. Schedule to SRE staging first.
alex: agreed. Action items: 1) RFC update with config contract + failover semantics (alex), 2) cert bootstrap spec (irene), 3) metrics/tracing schema (maya), 4) chaos plan + smoke tests (dave/sam). I'll draft RFC by EOD. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — add a short paragraph about billing implications (ephemeral NAT allocation vs relay egress).
alex: will do.
sam: small nit: define whether connector can rewrite Host header for SNI passthrough or we keep TLS passthrough only. Security prefers passthrough.
irene: passthrough preferred, yes. If we need termination, do it via explicit customer opt-in and audit logs.
dave: ok closing notes — rolling to staging next week, need owners for rollout checklist. I'll ping infra-oncall. :handshake:
